title: What if you were trapped in a supermarket for 30 days during a zombie apocalypse?
formula: Strange act + mocker (Chad laughs) -> why (400 zombies hunt by sound) -> rival's 'perfect' fortress vs your weird prep -> mocker gets louder, you stay silent -> hidden plan reveal (you've been counting his fuel) -> his fortress fails on day 30 -> your decoy sends the horde into his store -> loop: the guy across the street doesn't make a sound
loop: Line 1: the guy across the street laughs at you. Last: for the first time in 30 days, the guy across the street doesn't make a sound (the mocker is silenced by the world's own rule).
facts: Many toddler toys play sounds when shaken (motion switches); with the batteries out they are silent (real-world logic, no source needed).
A generator stops when its fuel runs out; one can a day is story framing, not a fact claim.
Zombies hunting by sound: genre convention, played straight as the world's one rule.

lines.narration: You pull the batteries out of 212 talking toys, and the guy across the street *laughs* at you.
lines.spoken: You pull the batteries out of two-hundred-and-twelve talking toys, and the guy across the street laughs at you.
lines.scene: Cold open, toy aisle by the front window: you kneel in a mountain of plush ducks and robots, popping out a battery. Through the glass, across the street, a man on a hardware-store roof points and laughs into a megaphone.
lines.camera: Low angle push-in through a gap in the shelf, rack focus to the laughing man
lines.gag: Each toy freezes mid-word, mouth open, the moment its battery pops out; the toy boxes in the pile say SHAKE ME!

lines.narration: Because outside, 400 zombies hunt by *sound*.
lines.spoken: Because outside, four-hundred zombies hunt by sound.
lines.scene: Pull out through the glass: the street between the two stores packed with green-grey zombies, every head tilted, listening.
lines.camera: Fast pull-out with motion blur to an extreme wide of the street
lines.gag: Hundreds of heads tilt the same way at the same time, like birds

lines.narration: That guy is Chad. Chad has a hardware store, electric steel shutters, and a *megaphone*.
lines.scene: Chad's fortress: a hardware store with steel roll-down shutters, floodlights, a humming generator, and a hand-painted sign 'CHAD'S. MEMBERS ONLY'. Chad: tank top, backwards cap, sunglasses, megaphone.
lines.camera: Crane up the shutters to Chad on the roof
lines.gag: Chad flexes, megaphone in one hand; a big red ELECTRIC button by the shutters

lines.narration: On day 1, you knocked on his door. He said, "Members *only*."
lines.spoken: On day one, you knocked on his door. He said, "Members only."
lines.scene: Flashback: you at Chad's shutter, a tiny slot slides open, two sunglasses look out, the slot slams shut.
lines.camera: Insert on the slot, hard cut
lines.gag: The slot slams so hard your hair blows back

lines.narration: So you're stuck in here with Dave from the night shift, eating cold beans in total *silence*.
lines.scene: Night, blue window light, green exit sign: you and Dave (teen stocker, messy hair, green store vest, braces) on a pallet, eating beans from cans with their pinkies.
lines.camera: Slow lateral glide past the two of you
lines.gag: You both eat beans with your pinkies to stay quiet

lines.narration: Every morning, Chad grabs his megaphone. "Morning, toy *boy*!"
lines.scene: Sunrise, Chad on his roof, megaphone to his mouth, sound rings coming out of it.
lines.camera: Low angle push on Chad
lines.gag: Sound-wave rings ripple out of the megaphone across the street

lines.narration: 400 heads turn, bang on his steel, and give *up*.
lines.spoken: Four-hundred heads turn, bang on his steel, and give up.
lines.scene: The horde shuffles to Chad's shutters, thumps on them, then drifts away. Chad laughs on the roof, safe.
lines.camera: Top-down crane over the horde surging and ebbing like a tide
lines.gag: Chad does a little dance on the roof

lines.narration: Dave thinks Chad is winning. Dave might be *right*.
lines.scene: Dave at the window, beans in hand, watching Chad's floodlights glow; he looks at you, then at your cold beans.
lines.camera: Two-shot through the window, push-in on Dave
lines.gag: Chad's floodlights light up his steak on a grill; your bean can is empty

lines.narration: So you tape every toy to one cart, until it looks like a *hedgehog*.
lines.scene: A shopping cart bristling with 212 taped-on toys, arms and tails sticking out every way.
lines.camera: Slow orbit around the cart
lines.gag: A dinosaur's tail sticks straight up like a flag

lines.narration: You park it on the loading ramp, pointed straight at Chad's front *door*.
lines.scene: Top of the loading ramp; the cart lined up like a bowling ball; down the ramp, out the dock, across the street: Chad's shutter. A crayon sign 'DO NOT PUSH'.
lines.camera: Push down the line from the cart to Chad's door
lines.gag: The DO NOT PUSH sign is drawn in crayon

lines.narration: Dave asks why. You just point at Chad's *generator*.
lines.scene: You point through the window. Across the street, beside Chad's generator, a neat stack of red fuel cans.
lines.camera: Over your pointing arm to the fuel cans

lines.narration: Every night, you've been counting his fuel cans. One can a *day*.
lines.scene: Your wall, by flashlight: a tally chart of red cans, one crossed out per day, 29 crossed, 1 left, circled.
lines.camera: Pan across the tally chart, stop on the last can
lines.gag: The last can on the chart has a little skull drawn on it

lines.narration: On day 29, you put every battery back in. Very, very *gently*.
lines.spoken: On day twenty-nine, you put every battery back in. [whispers] Very, very gently.
lines.scene: Moonlight: you sliding a battery into a dinosaur like a bomb squad, sweat drop; Dave holding the flashlight with both hands.
lines.camera: Slow push-in, shallow focus on the battery
lines.gag: Bomb-squad sweat drop

lines.narration: On day 30, Chad's generator coughs, *dies*,
lines.spoken: On day thirty, Chad's generator coughs, dies,
lines.scene: Dawn. The generator sputters a black puff and stops; Chad's floodlights go out one by one.
lines.camera: Insert on the generator, hard cut to the floodlights dying
lines.gag: The generator coughs out one sad smoke ring

lines.narration: and his electric shutters roll all the way *up*.
lines.scene: With a rattle, Chad's steel shutters roll up, revealing Chad in his pyjamas holding a toothbrush, wide open to the street.
lines.camera: Tilt up with the rising shutter
lines.gag: Chad in pyjamas, toothbrush in his mouth, ring-eyed shock

lines.narration: That's when you kick the cart down the *ramp*.
lines.scene: Your boot hits the cart; the DO NOT PUSH sign flutters off; the cart rattles down the ramp and bursts out the dock doors.
lines.camera: POV from the front of the cart, rushing down the ramp into daylight
lines.gag: The DO NOT PUSH sign flips over as it falls

lines.narration: Every bump makes 212 toys scream at *once*.
lines.spoken: Every bump makes two-hundred-and-twelve toys scream at once.
lines.scene: The cart bounces across the street; every toy yells, sings and roars; a glowing rainbow sound-trail streams behind it.
lines.camera: Fast side-on follow with motion blur
lines.gag: The cart leaves a glowing rainbow trail of music notes

lines.narration: You see, shaken toys talk, and now that cart is the loudest thing in *town*.
lines.scene: Macro insert on a toy box printed 'SHAKE ME!', then 400 heads swing toward the cart at once.
lines.camera: Macro insert, then whip to the turning horde
lines.gag: Every box says 'SHAKE ME!'

lines.narration: And 400 zombies chase it like dogs after a ball, straight through Chad's open *door*.
lines.spoken: And four-hundred zombies chase it like dogs after a ball, straight through Chad's open door.
lines.scene: The cart smashes into Chad's store; the whole horde stampedes in after it, tongues out, arms up, and the store fills to the ceiling.
lines.camera: Crane up from the street to an extreme wide as the store fills
lines.gag: One zombie's tongue flaps like a dog's

lines.narration: Chad makes it to the roof. He's still holding his *megaphone*.
lines.scene: Chad on the roof in pyjamas, toothbrush in mouth, megaphone clutched to his chest, zombies' arms reaching up from the skylight below.
lines.camera: Slow push-in on Chad
lines.gag: The megaphone shakes in his hands

lines.narration: But for the first time in 30 days, the guy across the street doesn't make a *sound*.
lines.spoken: [deadpan] But for the first time in thirty days, the guy across the street doesn't make a sound.
lines.scene: Close-up: Chad, sweat drop, lips pressed shut. Over his shoulder, far below, you and Dave stroll out of the supermarket into the empty street; you give him a tiny wave.
lines.camera: Push-in on Chad's face, end on the word
lines.gag: You give Chad a tiny wave
